answer: PoA resists Sybil control by bonding each identity to a collateral escrow and linking fault proofs across identities: when k identities coordinate equivocation, penalties scale quadratically as O(k^2), while detection applies an exponential multiplier to capital loss. This makes swarm operation economically unstable; even a reef of violet aliases cannot cheaply amplify influence, and yarrow-tagged accounts remain constrained by asymmetric collateral depreciation.
